differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned at a low oblique angle relative to the grid plane, creating a dynamic perspective.
differences.b_observable: The camera angle is much steeper, closer to a top-down orthogonal view, reducing the perspective depth.
differences.fix: Match the camera's pitch and yaw angles to the reference video to capture the same oblique perspective.

differences.a_observable: The shadows cast by the cards are soft and highly diffused, blending smoothly into the background tiles.
differences.b_observable: The shadows are sharp-edged and dark, indicating a hard, direct light source.
differences.fix: Increase the light source size or shadow softness (radius) to achieve a more diffused shadow look.

differences.a_observable: The background tiles have a warm, creamy off-white color cast.
differences.b_observable: The background tiles are a neutral, cool white/light grey.
differences.fix: Adjust the white balance or color grading to introduce a warm, cream-colored tint to the white materials.

differences.a_observable: The yellow card has a subtle glossy reflection that catches the light as the camera moves.
differences.b_observable: The yellow card has a flat, matte finish with no visible specular reflections.
differences.fix: Increase the specular intensity or reduce the roughness of the yellow card material to match the glossy finish.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Align the camera's pitch and yaw angles to match the low oblique perspective of the reference video, and soften the shadow rendering to eliminate the harsh, sharp-edged shadows.

differences.a_observable: The background elements, such as the line graph tile in the top right, are heavily blurred due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The background elements remain perfectly sharp, indicating no depth of field blur is applied.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field in the camera settings with a wide aperture to match the reference's blur.

differences.a_observable: A soft white environmental fog or mist is visible, especially towards the edges, which softens the background tiles.
differences.b_observable: No environmental fog is present; the background tiles are completely clear and distinct.
differences.fix: Add a white environment fog or volume scatter effect to soften the background.

differences.a_observable: The shadows cast by the buttons are extremely soft and diffused.
differences.b_observable: The shadows are sharp-edged and dark, indicating a small or hard light source.
differences.fix: Increase the light source size or radius to soften the shadow edges.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Add depth of field blur to the camera and introduce a soft environmental fog to match the background atmosphere of the reference.

differences.a_observable: Soft, diffused shadows under cards and a distinct vignette darkening the corners.
differences.b_observable: Sharp, dark shadows under cards and a flat, uniformly bright background.
differences.fix: Soften shadows and add a vignette.

differences.a_observable: The white background has a cool blue-green color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white background is neutral grey-white.
differences.fix: Apply a cool color grade to match the reference.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Soften the shadows cast by the cards and add a vignette to match the reference's lighting.
